description: Scrape multiple pages in one async job. Costs 1 credit per page. Max 100 pages. Returns a job_id. Pass either page_ids directly, or pass project_id to auto-select pending pages (filtered by has_data and excluding system pages by default). Haloscan-origin pages are skipped automatically (no Wayback snapshot).

exclude_system.description: Skip legal/info pages (contact, mentions-legales, CGV, privacy, a-propos, ...) when auto-selecting via project_id. Default true.

has_data.description: Filter auto-selected pages by SEO data. Requires project_id. haloscan=traffic>0 OR keywords, majestic=backlinks>0, any=either. Pages with zero SEO data will not rank again — filtering avoids wasting credits.

limit.description: Max pages to scrape when using project_id (default 50)

page_ids.description: Array of page UUIDs to scrape

project_id.description: Project UUID — auto-selects pending pages (use instead of page_ids)

name: scrape_bulk
